lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiFeO₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with a 16-atom unit cell containing Li₄Fe₄O₈ and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe and Li centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while O centers show two geometric neighbors, one Fe and one Li. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Fe and Li octahedra, plus edge-sharing among like octahedra.
